title: Lamb Biryani Vegan Alternative
description: A vegan twist on the traditional lamb biryani. The 'lamb' is replaced with tender portobello mushrooms, and the recipe maintains the rich, aromatic flavors of the original.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the mushrooms and onions.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork to separate the grains.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
